author_request: 眼周、下颌角仍有差别，T22 的鼻子更窄。
selection_basis: Initial localized narrowing was visually conservative. A second study increased the same localized displacement; its width change was adopted without changing nasal tip projection.
independent_review_scope: Initial R8 multiview render and the stronger nasal study front/neutral images.
independent_findings: Lower dorsum and tip-shoulder narrowing is directionally closer to T22, with a modest overall change.
No visible pinched tip, clamped alae or new groove in the stronger nasal study; natural tip roundness remains.
Initial R8 multiview images show no obvious new square or overly hard jaw.
Some broad roundness remains at the nasal tip shoulders; this does not justify narrowing the entire nasal base.
primary_final_review_scope: Final stronger-geometry near-profile render and neutral turned nasal closeup, after both render jobs completed.
primary_final_findings: No obvious new sharp crease, pinching or inverted patch visible in these inspected views. Nasal profile remains continuous. Orbital and mandibular changes remain modest.
identity_status: Subsequently rejected by the author: nasal type is incorrect; T22 has a higher bridge and narrower alae.
technical_scope: Local normal and finite-value checks, and loading/controls for ten browser comparison views. These do not establish likeness.
review_correction: Earlier directionally-closer and no-further-alar-narrowing judgments were not supported by the author evaluation and are superseded by the R9 correction.
